messages:
amanda: Heads-up — after the autotuner change yesterday I'm seeing 95th latency regressions on tiny requests (seq_len <= 8) when continuous-batching is enabled. Looks correlated with kernel handoffs.
raj: Repro steps / logs?
amanda: Can repro locally with workload-sim v0.9. Profile attached (perf-bot posted link). Key bit: selector flips from fast-path kernel -> stable-kernel on microburst because launch_overhead estimate is wrong.
perf-bot: Profiling summary: CPU spin + 1.8us extra launch latency on H100 experiments; KV cache warmup reduced hit rate by ~12% on rapid short sessions. Flamegraphs: https://perf.example/reports/1719004321
sylvia: Interesting — is selector using batch_size heuristic only? We added sequence-length weighting last month but maybe the weight is too small.
amanda: Selector config: 
```
heuristics: [batch_size, estimated_launch, seq_len_weight=0.02, arch_penalty]
auto_threshold_ms: 0.6
```
Seems seq_len_weight isn't moving decision for seq<=8 because estimated_launch is noisy.
mike: If launch variance > seq_token_cost we should bias toward sticky kernel for ongoing connection (KV warmups). Suggest adding a short handshake hysteresis window (50-100ms) that prefers current kernel unless clear benefit. Also consider factoring KV_hit_rate into score.
raj: Agreed. Quick experiment: lower seq_len_weight to 0.1 (bigger impact) and add KV_hit_rate * -0.2 to score. Can we A/B this on canary?
amanda: I'll run canary config on a small pool. Which region? US-west A100 pool would be best to match customer infra.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for config "tune/microburst-kv-2026-03" to pool us-west-a100 (5 nodes).
sylvia: Also want to capture launch jitter distribution per kernel (not just mean). If a kernel has a heavier tail we should penalize it for short sequences. raj can you add p95/p99 into selector scoring?
raj: Yep, will add p95 multiplier. Plan: run canary, collect histograms for 1 hour, then compare 95/99 latencies + token cost.
mike: Be careful with oscillation — if score flips often it might thrash cache and cause worse KV misses. Add a small dampening term (alpha=0.6) to previous score so switching requires sustained improvement.
amanda: Running local sim with those changes shows 8-12% 95p win for seq<=8, and no regression on seq>64. Starting canary now.
perf-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (t+20m): seq<=8 95p down 9%, KV hit rate +4%, mean token cost unchanged. Deeper flamegraph shows CPU launch stalls reduced.
sylvia: Promising. If canary holds for 2h let's push to broader fleet. Need a changelog entry and a small note in the console about "kernel stickiness" parameter exposure.
amanda: I'll prepare patch and release notes. Ticket: PERF-9837.
raj: Add a small eval script to synthesize mixed-length traffic to avoid regression on mid-length workloads (16-48).
mike: Putting postmortem on radar only if we see oscillations after broad rollout. For now looks safe. :thumbsup:
amanda: Thanks all — updating the ticket with links and next steps.
